requirement.text: Users must be informed when they are interacting with an AI system.

analysis.ethical_objective: Ensure transparency by informing users when an interaction is with an AI system.
required_behaviors: Inform users when they are interacting with an AI system.
constraints: The information must be provided in connection with users' interaction with the AI system.
The requirement applies to users; no other stakeholder groups are specified.
verification_targets: Whether a user is informed that they are interacting with an AI system.
Whether this information is presented when the user interacts with the AI system.
ambiguities: The requirement does not specify the form, content, wording, prominence, timing, frequency, or delivery channel of the information.
The requirement does not define what kinds of interaction are in scope or how the system should handle interactions that begin without an explicit user interface.
The requirement does not specify whether users must acknowledge, understand, or be able to opt out after being informed.
unsupported_inferences_to_avoid: Do not require a particular disclosure format, such as a banner, label, pop-up, voice notice, or consent dialog.
Do not prescribe exact wording, readability level, language support, placement, timing beyond the stated connection to interaction, or repeated-notification rules.
Do not add requirements for user consent, acknowledgement, opt-out, human handoff, explanation of AI decisions, or disclosure of model details.
Do not infer legal, regulatory, accessibility, privacy, fairness, or record-keeping obligations.
Do not assume a particular AI modality, interface, application domain, or implementation technology.

initial_draft.title: Inform Users of AI Interaction
initial_draft.description: As a user interacting with the system, I want to be informed that I am interacting with an AI system, so that I am aware of the AI nature of the interaction.
work_items: Ensure the system provides users with information that identifies the interaction as being with an AI system.
Verify, for interactions with the AI system, that the user is informed that the system is an AI system.
Do not treat the interaction as compliant unless the required information is provided to the user in connection with that interaction.

issues.problem: The work items state the required outcome but do not distinguish an implementation activity from a verification condition. This provides usable but limited guidance on how the team should operationalize disclosure without introducing unsupported design choices.
issues.recommended_change: Retain the technology-neutral wording, but structure the items explicitly as an implementation task and acceptance criteria—for example, identify each interaction with the AI system to the user, and verify that the identifying information is provided for each such interaction.

issues.problem: The verification items are directionally testable, but "for interactions with the AI system" does not define how the relevant interactions will be enumerated or sampled during verification. The source requirement does not supply a scope definition, so this cannot be made fully precise without practitioner context.
issues.recommended_change: State the acceptance condition against the applicable interaction scenarios identified by the project: for each applicable AI interaction scenario, verify that the user receives information identifying the system as AI. Do not add assumptions about interface, timing, wording, or disclosure format.
